copy the previous version as a start

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

2. Edit the contents

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Run build_test_workstation.py
publishes every version in bundle_sources

Re-publishing a version
that is already synced?
